react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN web deprecation warning still logged on app load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Carryover from iterations 1-5. Reference: fires from an overlay/pressable in the frontend tree (likely player or timeline nowLine overlay â€” nowLine style already uses pointerEvents inline prop in TimelineGrid.tsx:192).

action_items: OPTIONAL (unchanged from iter 4-5): migrate the last props.pointerEvents usage to style.pointerEvents. In /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:192 change `<View style={[styles.nowLine, { left: nowOffset, pointerEvents: 'none' }]} />` â€” the pointerEvents key sits inside the inline style object which triggers the RN web deprecation warning; move it to a separate style rule (e.g. styles.nowLine already has pointerEvents key set via StyleSheet) or use the JSX prop as pointerEvents='none'.

The device-crash fix itself (virtualization) can only be fully confirmed on the installed Android build; preview verification is a strong positive signal but cannot exercise real-device memory pressure.
critical_code_review_comments: TimelineGrid.tsx now uses two scroll-synced FlatLists (left sticky logo column + right program area) with getItemLayout, initialNumToRender=12, maxToRenderPerBatch=12, windowSize=7, removeClippedSubviews â€” verified in DOM: only ~34 rows mounted at rest out of 688, ruling out the OOM crash root cause reported for the built APK.

Scroll sync via scrollSource ref + syncFrom() is a clean approach that avoids feedback loops. Horizontal ScrollView wraps the right FlatList and drives header via onHScroll â€” sync is 1-way (source-of-truth = right list), which is correct.

api.ts: AbortController + setTimeout(25000) on GET and (45000) on refresh POST â€” resolves the 'spin forever' symptom by turning stalled fetches into surfaced errors. Cleanup with clearTimeout in finally-equivalent path is present.
store.tsx line 88: api.guide(12, start) â€” 12h default window confirmed, halves payload size vs. iter-5 24h window; backend /api/guide?hours=12 returns exactly 12h.

rca_of_issue: Reported bug: installed APK spun on channels/guide then crashed. RCA (per PRD): TimelineGrid formerly rendered all 688 channel rows in plain ScrollViews causing OOM on device. Fix landed in TimelineGrid.tsx: converted to two scroll-synced FlatLists with getItemLayout/windowSize=7/removeClippedSubviews, plus 25s/45s AbortController timeouts in api.ts and reduced default guide window from 24h to 12h (store.tsx:88). Preview validation: only 34 rows mounted vs 688 total (>95% memory reduction), scroll-sync works, program/channel taps work, no crash. Device-level confirmation still requires a fresh EAS build install â€” cannot be done from preview environment.
